verdict.rationale: WezTerm documents a `wezterm cli` subcommand for driving a running GUI or multiplexer instance: spawning programs and manipulating tabs and panes. A hands-on runtime probe confirmed a fully headless control loop: a daemonized mux-server, then spawn, send-text, get-text and list, with no GUI needed. Community use of get-text corroborates this. Missing for 10: a machine-readable API spec or LLM-oriented docs (llms.txt and OpenAPI both 404), and in-depth evidence of the full command reference or a scripting API beyond the CLI summary page.
